function.description: Returns result of a previously requested flow analysis by its Flow Analysis id
function.name: api_retrievesPreviousPathtrace

createTime.description: Timestamp when the Path Trace request was first received

destIP.description: IP Address of the destination device

id.description: Unique ID for the Path Trace request

inclusions.description: Subset of {INTERFACE-STATS, QOS-STATS, DEVICE-STATS, PERFORMANCE-STATS, ACL-TRACE}

lastUpdateTime.description: Last timestamp when the path trace response was updated

periodicRefresh.description: Re-run the Path Trace every 30 seconds

previousFlowAnalysisId.description: When periodicRefresh is true, this field holds the original Path Trace request ID

sourceIP.description: IP Address of the source device

status.description: One of {SUCCESS, INPROGRESS, FAILED, SCHEDULED, PENDING, COMPLETED}
